Name: farmerjack's Deer for 1.6
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
Permissions seem to allow an update for this one as long as credit is given, so I present farmerjack's BFAV Deer (found [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18742]here[/url]) for SDV 1.6. Credit for the original mod goes to farmerjack, of course (and if they come back and want me to take this down I will!)

Deer live in barns and produce milk that can be turned into cheese. I still have to work on reintegrating AHM compatibility.

Enjoy!
